text.source: Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice (1813), chapter 1, opening paragraphs: public domain. ASCII straight quotes; the exact characters are the `text` field, checked by its sha256.
text.text:
It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.

However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.

"My dear Mr. Bennet," said his lady to him one day, "have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?"

Mr. Bennet replied that he had not.

"But it is," returned she; "for Mrs. Long has just been here, and she told me all about it."

Mr. Bennet made no answer.

"Do you not want to know who has taken it?" cried his wife impatiently.

"You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it."

This was invitation enough.

conventions.layout_and_stream: make_kinds.py encode() / tile_stats(), imported unchanged (kinds.json facts)
conventions.fp16: IEEE round to nearest even of the fp32 activations and weights (an fp16 model would compute its activations in fp16; rounding the fp32 ones is the approximation)
conventions.int8: symmetric, zero point 0: weights per output channel, activations per tensor (max-abs over this text's 128 tokens), round half to even, clip +-127
conventions.attention: raw q and k (the 1/sqrt(64) scale is applied after the product)
conventions.rows: tokens 0..127 of the text; windows are aligned 16-row blocks, so a window may include token 0

predictions.what: FROZEN predictions for the real GPT-2 tiles, made before any card ran them: (a) D, the switching W over the type's own zeros at 600 MHz on aifoundry3 (E86), from a predictor fitted on E78's 51 kinds only; (E91) the same divided by E82's per-type card scale, for aifoundry1 card 1; (b) the burst and sustained clock on aifoundry2 under its own governor (E87), from E83's registered relation applied to (a)

predictor.form: per type, D = sum_i beta_i x_i with every beta_i >= 0 (exact NNLS), no intercept, so zeros predict 0; x from make_real.features() on the tile's issue stream and gate
predictor.selection: per type, the candidate with the lowest leave-one-kind-out rms over E78's kinds of that type (ties: fewer non-zero terms); the candidate list is CANDIDATES in make_real.py
predictor.interval: point +- t(0.975, n - p) x LOO rms, p = non-zero terms; floored at 0
predictor.fitted_on: E78's 51 kinds only: e78.json items.<type>.<kind>.D.mean and the committed tiles

relation_e83.conversion: c = c_E64(type, zeros) + D / (0.5218 / 0.517)^2, as E83 used
relation_e83.interval: the clock at the two ends of (a)'s 95% interval
